title: Bezos's grandfather Lawrence Gise ran the AEC's Western Division
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Bezos's grandfather Lawrence Gise ran the AEC's Western Division, about 1960s at Atomic Energy Commission, Western Division, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He was the director of the Western Division. Uh Harold Mgrren told me that story.

plain: Matthew Pines, a security analyst, says a man named Harold Malmgren told him that Lawrence Gise, the grandfather of Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, was director of the Western Division of the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency that ran nuclear weapons and energy work, in the 1960s. It is told to suggest that one of today's richest men has family ties to the secretive world of nuclear and defence research.
